Hi Emily — great questions. Short answers up top, details and proposed next steps below.

Quick answers:
- GCP CMEK: yes — we support CMEK for hosted deployments via GCP Cloud KMS (CMEK) today. We also support AWS CMEK and Azure BYOK variants.
- HSM requirement: optional. HSM-backed keys are supported for customers who need FIPS 140-2/3 or dedicated HSM appliances. The hosted CMEK flow uses Google-managed HSMs behind Cloud KMS; if you require customer-controlled HSMs (on-prem or customer-managed HSM cluster), we can integrate but it’s a longer integration (orientation and connectivity + key provisioning).
- Logs & telemetry: we can provide request/response metadata (headers, timestamps, token counts). We do not persist user-submitted content in our analytics logs by default — that’s configurable. Export options: signed audit log bundles (SHA256 + timestamped manifest) for up to X days (configurable).
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit and AES-256-GCM at rest across our hosted offerings.

What I propose for a low-friction POC (minimal ops overhead):
1) Hosted + CMEK (GCP) — customer provides the CMEK key resource name and grant to Redwood service account. No HSM handoff required initially.
2) Minimal logging profile: retain request metadata and truncated traces for 30 days; redact or hash PII fields (we will work with your data classification list to ensure redaction rules).
3) Signed audit log export every 24 hours to a secured bucket you control (we push to your GCS bucket with signed manifest).

Operational notes / caveats:
- BYOK via CMEK will require a short security onboarding call with our security engineering team to exchange principals and confirm key IAM bindings (30–45 minutes).
- If you later decide to require customer-controlled HSM appliances (KMIP/on-prem HSM), expect additional lead time (4–8 weeks depending on network configuration and attestation requirements).
- There is a modest pricing premium for CMEK hosting (covers key management ops and audit signing). If you require HSM appliances, there’s an SLA exception and dedicated support package.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sergio (cc’d) — can you schedule a 30-min onboarding call with Emily + her security engineer to confirm CMEK resource name and IAM grant steps?
- Marissa (cc’d) — please prepare a short pricing delta for hosted+CMEK and an estimate for HSM option + SLA exception language.
- Emily — if you can share the relevant lines from the security questionnaire (or a prioritized bullet list), we’ll answer in a single doc.

I’m attaching our BYO KMS matrix that outlines supported flows and expected lead times.

Best —
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
